title: Saudi Arabian Pork Belly Kebabs
description: Tender pork belly marinated in a blend of Saudi spices and grilled to perfection, served with a side of aromatic rice.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together adventurous spice mix, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork belly to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork belly from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until caramelized and cooked through.
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thick strips.
Serve with a side of aromatic rice and your favorite kebab toppings.
Optional: serve with additional adventurous spice mix on the side for added flavor.
